strings: r_c0 talks with m_c's parents about how much more sensitive {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/seem/seems} than other kittens. After some observation it seems that m_c might just have some disrupted senses.
Whenever m_c steps out of the nursery {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/whine/whines} and {VERB/m_c/retreat/retreats} back inside.
While {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nurserymates are already freely exploring and playing around camp, m_c whimpers and complains about the evil sun trying to blind {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c hates going outside, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} always {VERB/m_c/complain/complains} about the burning in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes.
m_c is always complaining about how everyone else in the Clan around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} is just too loud.
It often seems to take m_c multiple attempts before {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can understand what {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates are trying to tell {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c complains often about how the nest around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} feels like against {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt.
